{"id":"JMAP-0x0q.50","title":"Federation: DID-verified path for host-less DIDs","description":"Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[did-cid] Federation identity binding has no DID-verified path for host-less DIDs
Spec (b6028b3): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00.md L211 @6bcd9d8: "When the peer identity is a DID without a host (for example, a `did:key` or `did:plc` DID), the peer domain does not vouch for it, and {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}} accepts it only after the DID-bound verification defined here succeeds." L170: "A server advertising the `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:did` capability MUST be able to resolve DIDs of the following methods and verify signatures made by keys bound in their DID Documents"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:196-210 (authenticate: rejects anything not IdentityBinding::Bound, so NeedsDidVerification is always forbidden); crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:44-58 (AuthenticatedPeer: #[non_exhaustive], no DID-verified flag); crate-jmap-peer-auth/src/identity.rs:17-21, 42 (NeedsDidVerification is produced but nothing consumes it)
Now: Every did:key or did:plc peer identity is rejected, and nothing in the crates calls verify_did_signature. This conforms to federation-00 rule 3 (MUST NOT accept on peer auth alone), but a server that advertises chat:did can never federate with a host-less DID peer.
Change: Either (A) add a DID-verified marker to AuthenticatedPeer, set by the transport after the binding check of impact 1 succeeds (AuthenticatedPeer is non_exhaustive, so this is additive through a constructor or builder), and accept NeedsDidVerification in deliver.rs:204 only when it is set; or (B) keep rejecting and document that jmap-chat-federation-server does not accept host-less DID peers.
